scope: Final source-bound review of every required Aeliqo 0.1.0 component, with a fresh exact installed catalog consumer, all-entry mount/dispose proof, the requested WebKit catalog and interaction slice, and independent pixel inspection.

71/71 mounts, real renderer/compound boundaries, direct keyboard action and complete root disposal

decision.componentInventory: All 71 entries remain done and now reference this final independently reviewed visual-matrix artifact.
decision.task: T29 acceptance is satisfied and the task may be marked done.
decision.scenarios: S29 and S35 were already done. No additional scenario is directly completed by this review; S28 remains planned and deferredForRelease=true because manual screen-reader certification was not performed.

limits: Manual VoiceOver, NVDA or other assistive-technology certification was not performed or claimed.
The remaining Axe incomplete findings are retained and classified in measurements.json; none is a prohibited-ARIA finding or an unresolved observed contrast failure.
This evidence does not qualify T30, T31, T40, registry publication, site deployment or release promotion.
The reviewed captures prove the owned fixtures and states, not universal pixel equivalence for every consumer environment.
